reasonDefinitions.directFootContact: applyStrike -> wakeNode; magnitude is delivered node deltaV
reasonDefinitions.intraPlatePropagation: next-step energy e > WAKE_ENERGY -> wakeNeighborhood; magnitude is e
reasonDefinitions.zAdjacentCoupling: abs(combined linkForce) > 1e-8 -> wake linked Plate nodes; max components reported
reasonDefinitions.sphereFoundationCoupling: advanceNodules modal coupling abs(coupling) > 1e-8 -> wake foundation
reasonDefinitions.topologyReinstall: installTopology re-wakes a node that was already awake before recompilation

sleepDiagnostics.diagnosticScope: Detailed counters and per-node quiet maxima cover only the current oldest, middle, and newest Plate layers; other layers use the original sleep-check path.
sleepDiagnostics.blockerDenominator: selected-layer active node-step evaluations; each blocker is counted independently
